citations.assessment: The relevant local Achai notice explicitly gives Bar Hedya’s case and records the Achi reading.
Bar Hedya approaches Rabbi Achi, who is responsible for bills of divorce. Maintain the root’s differing name form at the pointer.
Bar Hedya describes standing before Rabbi Ammi, and the surrounding wording explains that Ammi was a priest.
Bar Hedya reports what he saw at Tiberias. Abaye then challenges whether it was done with the sages’ approval.
Bar Hedya and Ravin give competing accounts of whether the festival fell on Shabbat.
